note: Majority: the Civil Transactions Law issued by Federal Decree-Law No. 25 of 2025, in force from June 2026, article 84: full capacity at eighteen Gregorian years, replacing the 1985 law's twenty-one lunar years. Read from Al Tamimi & Company's note on the law, since the federal legislation portal (uaelegislation.gov.ae) refused this client (403); the court's permission to manage one's own property from fifteen is not held. Work: the Labour Law (Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021), article 5, per the government portal (u.ae, 'Employing minors'): employing a juvenile under fifteen is prohibited, and the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation issues no work permit below that age, to Emiratis or residents; from fifteen to eighteen a juvenile works on a ministry permit with conditions (not held). The page names no exception for a child performer, so one under fifteen is held as barred: a reading of the letter; a media-sector rule on child actors was looked for (web search, 2026-10-31) and not found. The law's own text wasn't read (the legislation portal answered 403, the Ministry reset the connection, and the PDF on u.ae answered 404). Service: Federal Law No. 6 of 2014 on National Military Service and the Reserve Force, as amended, per the government portal: national service is mandatory for every medically fit Emirati man, optional for women; the term is eleven months for a man with a secondary-school certificate or higher (three years for one without, not held) and eleven months for a woman who volunteers. The ages are read from the same page: postponement is allowed to a man who reaches eighteen still at school, a man who doesn't enlist by twenty-nine is punished, and service is owed past the age limit of thirty; held as eighteen to thirty, a reading. The service applies to citizens only.

sources.title: The UAE Government portal (u.ae): Employing minors
sources.said: it is prohibited to employ juveniles under the age of 15). Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation does not issue work permits to juveniles below this age, whether Emiratis or expatriate residents.

sources.title: Al Tamimi & Company: UAE Civil Transactions Law (Federal Decree-Law No. 25 of 2025), note of February 2026
sources.said: A fundamental change introduced by the new law is the reduction of the age of legal majority from 21 to 18 years. ... (a) Age of Majority Reduced to 18 (Article 84) ... Have reached 18 Gregorian years;

sources.title: The UAE Government portal (u.ae): Work permits
sources.said: It enables establishments to recruit a juvenile aged between 15 and 18 years, under specific conditions that ensure a safe and appropriate working environment for minors. ... The worker must be at least 18 years old, except in the case of a juvenile work permit or a student training/employment permit.

sources.title: The UAE Government portal (u.ae): Armed Forces, mandatory national service
sources.said: it is mandatory for all medically fit Emirati men to accomplish the national service ... According to the law, the service is optional for women, regardless of their education. ... the national service term for male recruits holding a high school diploma or its equivalent and above has been shortened to 11months ... They will have to undergo the military service even if they exceed the age limit of 30. ... reaching 18 years old and has not completed secondary education
